newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil up on strong futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil up on strong futures.

text.p: Gasoline and gas oil gained in northern Europe on Friday on good demand while naphtha and fuel slipped in quiet trade.
Gasoline was steady on crude and expectations of more demand next week. Prompt storage material saw aggressive selling, but running refinery traded at $192 and $193 fob ARA.
Naphtha was weaker. Late on Friday a Russian cargo was offered at $182 cif Rot, but bids were $176 and $178.
Gas oil gained up to $3 a tonne on the back of stronger futures and firm premiums that continue to be underpinned by Asia drawing product eastwards.

Fuel oil markets were quiet with traders cautious over future price movements. Barges were done in a range from $82-$84 and cargoes were discussed $79-$81 cif. Low sulphur looks well supplied, with values set to fade. - London newsroom +44 171 542 8060
